data.name: Yosemite Valley Walking Tour
data.description: This private, guided walk combines a little hiking, some photography, and a dash of history. You’ll visit all the highlights of the valley, like Yosemite Falls, Half Dome, spot rock climbers with binoculars, and wade in the Merced River!

meeting_point.address: Kiosk at Yosemite Falls Parking Lot, Yosemite, CA US

data.cancellation_notes:
Policy: Full payment due at booking

Cancel 30+ days → full refund minus platform & CC fees

Cancel 7–29 days → 50% refund minus fees

Cancel 0–6 days → no refund

Trips are never canceled due to weather
data.booking_notes:
Packing List:
•  Sun Hat
•  Sunglasses
•  Water Bottles (1L)
•  Sunscreen
•  Bug Spray
•  Raincoat
•  Warm Layer
•  Swimsuit
•  Small towel

Optional:
•  Cash, to tip your guide!
•  Sandals, for wading in the river

*We will provide backpacks, trekking poles, water filter, snacks and lunch!*
